name: CubeChella 2018
information:
* **The cost of registration is a $20 flat fee. Payments are taken after registering. We will not be taking registrations or payments at the door.**
* Fees will go towards the Palm Desert Church of Christ Youth Group and the use of the venue.
* Spectating is free and open the the public. Photography and videography are permitted, however there shall be **NO FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY.**
* Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years - thanks!
* **Additional Information**
* Please be respectful of the venue and do not go into rooms that are not included for the competition.
We wish to keep the venue as clean as possible; doing this will guarantee use of venue for future competitions and will ease the clean up process after the competition ends.
